entities.summary: Danail Tsonev Nikolaev was a Bulgarian officer and Minister of War on the eve of the Balkan Wars. He was the first person to attain the highest rank in the Bulgarian military, General of the infantry. He was also known as "the patriarch of the Bulgarian military".
